title: Premium Map POC: The Ashen Crucible
theme: Volcanic fire-temple ruin with basalt stairs, broken bridges, and a dangerous cinder relic
hook: The smoke above an abandoned fire temple has begun pulsing like a signal. A nearby caravan hires the party to recover the Cinder Lens before the old vents open under the trade road.
background: The Ashen Crucible was built to control a line of volcanic vents beneath the pass. Its bridge-spans have cracked, its forge platforms hang above old heat wells, and the Cinder Lens has started focusing smoke toward the trade road again. The party must reach the eastern ledge, secure or cover the lens, and decide whether to appease the Brand-Keeper before the temple vents reopen.

layout.notes: Map-first illustrated volcanic ruin: lower stair landing, central crucible platform, eastern objective ledge, upper vents, and a hidden hazardous trail between the cinder archive and smoke gallery.

connections.note: Hidden ash trail behind cracked vent-stones between the archive and ember intake

playerSafe.description: A player-safe illustrated volcanic ruin map. Keyed numbers remain visible, but GM markers and the hidden ash trail are not shown.

rooms.name: Ashen Lower Stair
rooms.readAloud: A black stair climbs from a drift of warm ash. Each step is cut from basalt and edged with old bronze pins gone green-black with heat.
rooms.gmNotes: This is the safest entry. Soot marks show recent movement up toward the crucible platform and across to the eastern objective ledge.
rooms.treasure: A heat-blued pilgrim token lies wedged under the third stair.
rooms.secrets: Fine ash on the left wall points toward hidden ventilation routes elsewhere in the ruin.
rooms.exits: Up the clear stair to Room 2, or along the lower basalt stair to Room 3.

rooms.name: Central Crucible Platform
rooms.readAloud: A broad platform of cracked stone hangs above a dark heat well. Broken bridge arms, stairs, and smoke-stained corridors radiate from its rim.
rooms.gmNotes: This hub controls the pace of the site. The blocked eastern bridge to Room 3 can be crossed only after clearing rubble or finding another route around.

inhabitants.name: Coal-Veiled Watchers
inhabitants.tactics: Circle the heat well, force intruders toward cracked edges, and retreat through smoke gaps
inhabitants.morale: Scatter if the old crucible oath is spoken or the Cinder Lens is covered
inhabitants.wants: No one to restart the temple vents
inhabitants.leverage: They respect careful movement, covered flames, and returned forge tokens

rooms.treasure: A loose bronze bridge pin can be sold or used to lever blocked stones.
rooms.secrets: The platform smoke pulls toward a hidden ash trail between Room 5 and Room 6.

rooms.name: Cinder Lens Ledge
rooms.readAloud: An exposed eastern ledge overlooks the hottest vents. A black glass lens rests in a cracked cradle near a treasure alcove of fused metal.
rooms.gmNotes: The bridge from Room 2 is blocked, but the stair from Room 1 and the hazardous upper trail from Room 4 can still reach this ledge. The objective and treasure are both here.
rooms.treasure: Fused silver ingots, a scorched tool roll, and the Cinder Lens in its cracked cradle.
rooms.secrets: The lens dims when pointed toward a safe crossing and flares near unstable volcanic glass.

rooms.treasure: A vent-stone stamped with the old fire temple seal.
rooms.secrets: A timed exhale from this vent reveals the safest rhythm for crossing the hazardous trail to Room 3.

rooms.treasure: Three fire-glazed tablets describing how to shutter the crucible vents.
rooms.secrets: A hidden ash trail behind cracked vent-stones leads hazardously to Room 6.

rooms.gmNotes: This area is a safer way to read the temple machinery from below. The hidden trail from Room 5 exits behind a warped grate.
rooms.treasure: A removable brass grate key with heat-proof wrapping.
rooms.secrets: The hidden hazardous ash trail from Room 5 emerges behind the warped western grate.

rooms.name: Smoke Gallery Of The Brand-Keeper
rooms.readAloud: A lower gallery opens beside a wall of blackened statues. One figure still holds a glowing brand, though no hand should be warm enough to bear it.
rooms.gmNotes: The boss marker belongs here. The Brand-Keeper challenges anyone carrying the Cinder Lens or bridge pin.

inhabitants.name: Brand-Keeper Remnant
inhabitants.tactics: Blocks the stair, brands the floor with warning lines, and punishes thieves before negotiators
inhabitants.morale: Yields if the party swears to shutter the vents rather than steal temple fire
inhabitants.wants: The Cinder Lens kept from anyone who would reopen the crucible
inhabitants.leverage: Can be reasoned with using archive tablets, forge tokens, or proof the road is in danger

rooms.treasure: The brand itself cools into a black iron key if the remnant is appeased.
rooms.secrets: The statues face the true path to the archive vent-stone in Room 5.

gmNotes: Use the visible basalt platforms, stairs, bridges, and vents as the play surface; heat, height, and broken crossings should shape choices.
Normal route overlays are disabled on the premium map because the art already shows the visible routes.
The bridge from Room 2 to Room 3 is structurally blocked, but remains a known normal connection for table play and problem solving.
The secret route between Rooms 5 and 6 is described in room text and structured exits, but has no separate visible route overlay in the pasted premiumMap metadata.
